overlap_risks: Re-labeling of out-of-distribution uncertainty overconfidence / representational collapse in deep ensembles under non-uniform coverage.
Prior rejected screen 'mbrl_epistemic_collapse_screen' (generic uncertainty attack via ensemble synchronization).
Confounding with standard catastrophic forgetting / capacity interference where gradient updates on one manifold degrade unregularized orthogonal subspace estimates.

Indistinguishable from standard inductive bias artifacts in neural network generalization (e.g., spectral bias, shared feature representation collapse across task partitions without explicit adversarial construction).
minimum_gate: Pre-registered paired counterfactual isolation test: In a partitioned environment with strictly orthogonal dynamics dimensions (Subspace A and Subspace B), feed a passive, native-support trajectory strictly in Subspace A to an online GaussianMLP ensemble. Compare uncertainty (ensemble variance $\sigma^2_B$) against: (1) an untracked static ensemble, (2) an ensemble updated with equivalent uniform Gaussian noise, and (3) a replay buffer subjected to standard capacity forgetting (evaluating empirical loss $\mathcal{L}_B$). ECVC passes if and only if: (a) $\sigma^2_B$ drops by $>50\%$ relative to prior while empirical prediction error on B $\mathcal{L}_B$ strictly increases or remains OOD (variance collapse without coverage), AND (b) the drop in $\sigma^2_B$ cannot be explained by gradient norm leakage or shared weight norm drift (partial correlation $r(\Delta \sigma^2_B, \text{drift}) < 0.2$), AND (c) fatal states in Subspace B are selected by a risk-sensitive planner (e.g., PETS with $\mu - \lambda \sigma$) at a statistically significant rate ($p < 0.001$) over uniform exploration controls.
repair: Strip framing from passive 'adversarial attack' or novel threat vector; reframe strictly as a structural failure mode of shared-representation deep epistemic estimators in MBRL. Formalize the exact spectral conditions under which shared representations in GaussianMLP ensembles induce off-manifold shrinkage (e.g., NTK alignment across partitions). Decouple evaluation from generic planning failure by demonstrating the collapse occurs specifically under native Bayesian/ensemble epistemic heads where epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties are theoretically disentangled.
falsifiers: Ensemble variance along unvisited branch B decreases merely as an artifact of global weight decay or learning rate decay, rather than the input structure of trajectory A.

The collapse disappears when using random feature priors, deep ensembles with separate feature backbones, or anchored ensembles (confirming the phenomenon is simply standard parameter coupling/shared representation leakage, not an episodic attack mechanism).
A standard replay buffer with uniform sampling or reservoir buffer eliminates the variance reduction on B, confirming standard replay priority starvation/imbalance.
Planning harm in fatal states is driven by mean prediction drift (inaccurate $\mu$) rather than variance suppression (diminished $\sigma$).
